answer: Rate-limit new identities with a quota that shrinks as a funder spawns more: a wallet may register one agent per 4 epochs, then per 8, then 16, doubling each time. Fakes cannot find a haven in cheap bulk, since the nth clone waits 2^n windows, like a walnut ripening slowly. Validators audit registration timestamps on the public ledger, and any violet-flagged burst is rejected.
